name: Cubetor India Private Limited.
india_angle: Cubetor India Private Limited is based in India and offers its services, including cleanroom and HVAC solutions, to various industries including semiconductors.
summary: Cubetor India Private Limited specializes in designing and building cleanrooms and HVAC systems, which are critical for maintaining controlled environments in semiconductor manufacturing facilities. They provide turnkey project solutions, ensuring fully integrated and compliant facilities for the semiconductor industry.
